dashboard.label: Load Demo Data
dashboard.description: One-click load of bundled demo CSV data into demo_servicenow and demo_security indexes. No Data Inputs required.

div.p: Load synthetic ServiceNow and ES/Mission Control data without scripted inputs.

div.div: Prerequisite: create indexes demo_servicenow and demo_security before loading.

div.p: Run this in Search first. You should see 5 rows:
If you get an error, reinstall the latest demo_servicenow_es.tar.gz from the repository upload/ folder.
Open this saved search and click Run once. It loads ServiceNow + ES/Mission Control data.
Each link opens a saved search. Click the green Run button once per link.

div.div: index=demo_servicenow OR index=demo_security | stats count by index sourcetype
div.p: Then open SOC Case Management or continue Demo Setup.
If links do not work, paste each block into Search and run once:
div.div:
| inputlookup servicenow_incidents_demo | eval _time=coalesce(strptime(opened_at,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), strptime(sys_updated_on,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), now()) | collect index=demo_servicenow sourcetype=demo:snow:incident addtime=false marker=0
| inputlookup servicenow_changes_demo | eval _time=coalesce(strptime(opened_at,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), strptime(sys_updated_on,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), now()) | collect index=demo_servicenow sourcetype=demo:snow:change addtime=false marker=0
| inputlookup servicenow_cmdb_demo | eval _time=coalesce(strptime(sys_updated_on,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), strptime(sys_created_on,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), now()) | collect index=demo_servicenow sourcetype=demo:snow:cmdb_ci addtime=false marker=0
| inputlookup servicenow_users_demo | eval _time=coalesce(strptime(sys_updated_on,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), strptime(sys_created_on,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), now()) | collect index=demo_servicenow sourcetype=demo:snow:user addtime=false marker=0
| inputlookup servicenow_task_ci_demo | eval _time=coalesce(strptime(sys_updated_on,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), strptime(sys_created_on,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), now()) | collect index=demo_servicenow sourcetype=demo:snow:task_ci addtime=false marker=0
| inputlookup es_incidents_demo | eval _time=coalesce(strptime(_time,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), strptime(timestamp,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), now()) | collect index=demo_security sourcetype=demo:es:incident addtime=false marker=0
